classes.name: TopoDS_Builder
classes.summary:
A Builder is used to create Topological Data Structures. It is the root of the Builder class hierarchy.
There are three groups of methods in the Builder:
The Make methods create Shapes.
The Add method includes a Shape in another Shape.
The Remove method removes a Shape from an other Shape.
The methods in Builder are not static. They can be redefined in inherited builders.
This Builder does not provide methods to Make Vertices, Edges, Faces, Shells or Solids. These methods are provided in the inherited Builders as they must provide the geometry.
The Add method check for the following rules:
- Any SHAPE can be added in a COMPOUND.
- Only SOLID can be added in a COMPSOLID.
- Only SHELL, EDGE and VERTEX can be added in a SOLID. EDGE and VERTEX as to be INTERNAL or EXTERNAL.
- Only FACE can be added in a SHELL.
- Only WIRE and VERTEX can be added in a FACE. VERTEX as to be INTERNAL or EXTERNAL.
- Only EDGE can be added in a WIRE.
- Only VERTEX can be added in an EDGE.
- Nothing can be added in a VERTEX.

classes.name: TopoDS_Compound
classes.summary:
Describes a compound which.
- references an underlying compound with the potential to be given a location and an orientation
- has a location for the underlying compound, giving its placement in the local coordinate system
- has an orientation for the underlying compound, in terms of its geometry (as opposed to orientation in relation to other shapes). Casts shape S to the more specialized return type, Compound.

classes.name: TopoDS_Iterator
classes.summary: Iterates on the underlying shape underlying a given {@link TopoDS_Shape | `TopoDS_Shape`} object, providing access to its component sub-shapes. Each component shape is returned as a {@link TopoDS_Shape | `TopoDS_Shape`} with an orientation, and a compound of the original values and the relative values.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment:
Creates an {@link Iterator | `Iterator`} on sub-shapes. Note:
- If cumOri is true, the function composes all sub-shapes with the orientation of S.
- If cumLoc is true, the function multiplies all sub-shapes by the location of S, i.e. it applies to each sub-shape the transformation that is associated with S.

instanceMethods.name: Initialize
instanceMethods.signature: (S: TopoDS_Shape, cumOri?: boolean, cumLoc?: boolean): void
instanceMethods.comment:
Initializes this iterator with shape S. Note:
- If cumOri is true, the function composes all sub-shapes with the orientation of S.
- If cumLoc is true, the function multiplies all sub-shapes by the location of S, i.e. it applies to each sub-shape the transformation that is associated with S.

instanceMethods.name: More
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if there is another sub-shape in the shape which this iterator is scanning.

instanceMethods.name: Next
instanceMethods.comment: Moves on to the next sub-shape in the shape which this iterator is scanning. Exceptions Standard_NoMoreObject if there are no more sub-shapes in the shape.

instanceMethods.name: Value
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the current sub-shape in the shape which this iterator is scanning. Exceptions Standard_NoSuchObject if there is no current sub-shape.

instanceMethods.name: end
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a sentinel marking the end of iteration.

classes.name: TopoDS_Shape
classes.summary:
Describes a shape which.
- references an underlying shape with the potential to be given a location and an orientation
- has a location for the underlying shape, giving its placement in the local coordinate system
- has an orientation for the underlying shape, in terms of its geometry (as opposed to orientation in relation to other shapes). Note: A Shape is empty if it references an underlying shape which has an empty list of shapes.

constructors.name: constructor
constructors.comment: Creates a NULL Shape referring to nothing.

instanceMethods.name: IsNull
instanceMethods.comment: Returns true if this shape is null. In other words, it references no underlying shape with the potential to be given a location and an orientation.

instanceMethods.name: Nullify
instanceMethods.comment: Destroys the reference to the underlying shape stored in this shape. As a result, this shape becomes null.

instanceMethods.name: Location
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the shape local coordinate system.

instanceMethods.name: Location
Located
Oriented
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a shape similar to <me> with the orientation set to <Or>.

instanceMethods.name: TShape
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a handle to the actual shape implementation.

instanceMethods.name: ShapeType
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the value of the `TopAbs_ShapeEnum` enumeration that corresponds to this shape, for example VERTEX, EDGE, and so on. Exceptions Standard_NullObject if this shape is null.

instanceMethods.name: Move
Moved
Reverse
instanceMethods.comment: Reverses the orientation, using the Reverse method from the {@link TopAbs | `TopAbs`} package.

instanceMethods.name: Reversed
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a shape similar to <me> with the orientation reversed, using the Reverse method from the {@link TopAbs | `TopAbs`} package.

instanceMethods.name: Complement
instanceMethods.comment: Complements the orientation, using the Complement method from the {@link TopAbs | `TopAbs`} package.

instanceMethods.name: Complemented
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a shape similar to <me> with the orientation complemented, using the Complement method from the {@link TopAbs | `TopAbs`} package.

instanceMethods.name: Compose
instanceMethods.comment: Updates the Shape Orientation by composition with theOrient, using the Compose method from the {@link TopAbs | `TopAbs`} package.

instanceMethods.name: Composed
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a shape similar to <me> with the orientation composed with theOrient, using the Compose method from the {@link TopAbs | `TopAbs`} package.

instanceMethods.name: NbChildren
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns the number of direct sub-shapes (children).
@see {@link TopoDS_Iterator | `TopoDS_Iterator`}

instanceMethods.name: IsPartner
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if two shapes are partners, i.e. if they share the same TShape. Locations and Orientations may differ.

instanceMethods.name: IsSame
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if two shapes are same, i.e. if they share the same TShape with the same Locations. Orientations may differ.

instanceMethods.name: IsEqual
instanceMethods.comment: Returns True if two shapes are equal, i.e. if they share the same TShape with the same Locations and Orientations.

instanceMethods.name: EmptyCopy
instanceMethods.comment: Replace <me> by a new Shape with the same Orientation and Location and a new TShape with the same geometry and no sub-shapes.

instanceMethods.name: EmptyCopied
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a new Shape with the same Orientation and Location and a new TShape with the same geometry and no sub-shapes.

classes.name: TopoDS_TShape
classes.summary:
A TShape is a topological structure describing a set of points in a 2D or 3D space.
A topological shape is a structure made from other shapes. This is a deferred class used to support topological objects.
TShapes are defined by their optional domain (geometry) and their components (other TShapes with Locations and Orientations). The components are stored in a list in the base class.
A TShape contains the following boolean flags:
- Free : Free or Frozen.
- Modified : Has been modified.
- Checked : Has been checked.
- Orientable : Can be oriented.
- Closed : Is closed (note that only Wires and Shells may be closed).
- Infinite : Is infinite.
- Convex : Is convex.
- Locked : Is locked against modifications.
Users have no direct access to the classes derived from TShape. They handle them with the classes derived from Shape.

instanceMethods.name: ShapeType
instanceMethods.comment: Returns the type as a term of the ShapeEnum enum: VERTEX, EDGE, WIRE, FACE, SHELL, SOLID, COMPSOLID, COMPOUND. The type is embedded in the lower 4 bits of the state.

instanceMethods.name: EmptyCopy
instanceMethods.comment: Returns a copy of the TShape with no sub-shapes.

instanceMethods.name: NbChildren
instanceMethods.comment:
Returns the number of direct sub-shapes (children).
@see {@link TopoDS_Iterator | `TopoDS_Iterator`}
